_about: Side, valley and rear-gallery detail. Block coords (x passenger, y forward from the rear face, z up from the crank centreline). Wall points are given as (y, h): h is the distance up the side water-jacket wall from its lower edge, along the bore axis.

freeze_plugs.src: y [meas] album photo 431 rectified (brass cups, 3 per side, left bank 1" ahead of the right); d 1.75" [spec, BBC core plug]; height up the wall [est], 1.55 in (was 2.15): low enough that the right bank's bottom-row head studs (1.75 in into the deck) clear the cups now that the right deck is the left deck turned round

mount_holes.src: [est] three 3/8-16 motor-mount holes per side round the front freeze plug, on spot-faced pads (photo 431 shows tapped bosses there); for the ENS-3-1114G mounts

fuel_pump.src: [est] Gen VI fuel-pump boss on the passenger side at the front (block 19170540 has the boss); 2 x 3/8-16 and the pushrod opening

lifters.src: [spec] .8437" bores, 16. Boss tops about 2.3" either side of the centreline [meas] from album photo 545 (scaled by the 4.84" bore spacing), which gives a 38 deg tilt from vertical through the cam centre [derived]; the two bores of each pair are offset across the bank: the forward bore sits ~.22" further outboard [meas] photo 545 (passenger bank 15-20 px over the 85-105 px pair spacing), confirmed by the angled bosses in photo 27; bores start .5" from the cam centre so they open fully into the cam tunnel (at 1.0" the lifter roller clipped the tunnel edge)
lifters.y_src: [meas]/[derived] front and rear lifter y of each pair, cylinders front to rear (L 1,3,5,7; R 2,4,6,8). Pair spacing 1.80" [meas] from album photo 545 (pair spacing / bore spacing, 3 bosses: 1.77-1.83"; a camera solve from the 8 deck bores gives 1.5-2.0"). It was 1.30", which left 0.30" between the 2E and 1I lobes. Pairs are centred on their cylinders, except cylinders 7 and 8, whose lobes must fit between the distributor gear (y 3.70, [meas]) and cam journal 4: that group is shifted .39" forward, giving an even .90" lobe pitch [derived]. Each lifter sits over its own cam lobe; front lifter is the exhaust on the left bank (1,3,5,7) and the intake on the right (2,4,6,8): BBC heads run E-I-E-I on the left and I-E-I-E on the right (lobe order 1E 2I 1I 2E ...; ../heads/PARTS.md).

rear_plugs_src: [est] lifter and main oil-gallery plugs at the rear face, on the same gallery lines as the front plugs (photo 29)

boss.src: [meas] photos 545/547: each cylinder's two lifters share one dog-bone boss with a machined top square to the lifter axes, rising out of the floor and blending into the wall; outer radius [est]. Top height [derived] from the lifters (../lifters): OE-style Gen VI hydraulic rollers, 2.66" seat height [spec], sit on the cam's .585" base circle with their tops about .10" above the .09" stainless guide plates (album photo 351), which puts the boss top 3.524" along the lifter axis from the cam centre, z 7.92 at the bore (it was 8.10 [est] from the photo scale)

drain_slots.src: [meas] photo 545: 4 windows on the centreline, open onto the cam lobes, centred between each left/right boss pair

spider_boss.src: [meas] photo 545: a round boss with a tapped hole just ahead of each window (lifter retainer / spider bolt); photo PXL_20251220_223513946 and album 351/352 show them as slim pillars standing about .9" above the lifter-boss tops, well below the deck edge; sizes [est]

dist_boss.src: [meas] photo 545: raised round boss round the distributor bore at the rear; size [est]

valley.galleries_src: [derived] lifter galleries and the main gallery drilled front to rear between the front and rear plugs; the lifter galleries break into the lifter bores

distributor.src: [meas] Drew's photo PXL_20251220_223513946, camera solved from the deck: bore on the centreline 3.7" from the rear face, just ahead of the rear china wall, its boss top about .85" above the valley floor; bore size and depth [est]
